verdict.rationale: Firebase's own docs say that upgrading to Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform unlocks multi-factor authentication plus SAML and generic OpenID Connect support, so the core capabilities are first-party. They sit behind that upgrade, though, and the evidence never shows MFA being enforced (required) for users. Missing for 10: documented MFA enforcement/policy controls, SSO configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration, and availability without the Identity Platform upgrade.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can require MFA and enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) for my application users

citations.quote: When you upgrade to Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform, you unlock additional features, such as multi-factor authentication, blocking functions, user activity and audit logging, SAML and generic OpenID Connect support, multi-tenancy, and enterprise-level support.
